records.text: Sigmund Freud knew children were being abused in Vienna and created psychology to gaslight those children.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Freud knew that the children were being abused in Vienna and he created a social science psychology to help gaslight those children.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Freud encountered patient reports and theories involving childhood sexual abuse, but the compound claim that he knew abuse was pervasive throughout Vienna and created psychology specifically to gaslight victims attributes a broad prevalence finding and deliberate motive that the historical sources do not establish. The historical premise has support; the motive/conspiracy conclusion does not.

sources.title: Jeffrey Masson and Freud's seduction theory: a new fable based on old myths
sources.relevance: Scholarly review of Freud's seduction theory and the contested historical interpretation; does not substantiate the alleged deliberate gaslighting motive.

records.text: Hollywood imported people from Vienna and tasked them with destroying Christianity.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I really don't see how you can have a ton of success in Hollywood and not be in the club because Hollywood was founded upon this Hollywood Babylon. We spoke to you about this in our book club. They quite literally imported people from Vienna where Sigmund Freud was, where his boys were. They imported them and they made them directors. They made them actors. They made them actresses. And they were tasked with destroying Christianity.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Histories document the migration of many Central European artists and intellectuals to Hollywood, including refugees from Nazism, but no credible source establishes a coordinated importation of Viennese people for the purpose of destroying Christianity. The asserted intent is conspiratorial and unsupported.

sources.title: U.S. Holocaust Memorial Museum: German Jewish Refugees, 1933–1939
sources.relevance: Provides historical migration context but does not substantiate the alleged coordinated anti-Christian purpose.
